title: Feedback Loop Product Architecture
purpose: Design how use, outcomes, corrections, and unmet needs become governed product improvements rather than silent or unmanaged adaptation.

eventKinds.outcome: Evidence about whether the product produced the intended result.
eventKinds.correction: A user or reviewer identifies an error, harmful result, or needed override.
eventKinds.unmet-need: A job, affected group, or condition the product does not yet serve.

inheritedInfrastructure.implementation: assessFeedbackLoop reuses humanReviewScore and humanReviewGrade so a feedback loop must specify trigger, evidence, authority, escalation, notification, validation, capacity, and records.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework 1.0
sources.use: Roles, oversight, measurement, monitoring, and risk-management lifecycle grounding.

sources.title: Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction
sources.use: Granular feedback, correction, control, notification, and learning-over-time interaction grounding.

sources.title: Service Standard and performance-measurement guidance
sources.use: Combine performance evidence with user research and iterate services frequently.

sources.title: Privacy Principles
sources.use: Purpose limitation and data minimization for feedback and analytics capture.

productHeuristics: Four event kinds are a coverage model, not a universal ontology.
String-completeness thresholds are interface heuristics, not proof of operational adequacy.
GOVERNED LOOP is a design-readiness signal, not a safety, legal, privacy, accessibility, or product-market-fit determination.
limitations: No network, analytics vendor, model training, automated prioritization, or production deployment occurs.
Export remains local to the browser.
A real implementation requires domain validation, representative research, privacy review, security review, and accountable release authority.
